name: docudetect
description: Prepare, send and track PDFs for signature in your DocuDetect account from a conversation: upload a PDF, place and check signature, text, date and checkbox fields, audit templates for missed fields, fill in known values, copy documents for each new client or property, send to the signer when you say so, see who opened or signed, remind or cancel, and organise folders. It never signs or deletes.

interface.longDescription:
DocuDetect prepares, sends and tracks PDFs for signature in your DocuDetect account from a conversation. It handles the repetitive setup work and sends only when you ask it to.

What you can ask for:
- Upload a PDF as a new draft, in the conversation or through a one-time upload link.
- Detect form fields on the PDF, preview any page with the fields drawn on it, and place signature, text, date and checkbox fields once you agree with them.
- Fill in values you provide, such as your name, license number or a property address, onto fields that already exist. Positions you adjusted by hand do not move. Signature fields are never filled.
- Copy a master form into a new folder for each client or property.
- Set the single signer of a draft from a name and email address you give.
- Check a template for missed, duplicated or misplaced fields and fix them with you.
- Check what still blocks a draft, then send it to the signer when you say so.
- See whether the signer has opened or signed it, send a reminder, a fresh link when one expires, or cancel the request.
- Email you a completed, signed copy.
- List, search and organise your documents and folders.

What it will not do: sign for anyone, delete anything, open links on its own, or send without your request. Email goes only to the signer you named or to an address you give for a signed copy.

Permissions: you approve the connection on a DocuDetect page, and you choose whether it may make changes and whether it may send. A read-only connection can list and read documents, preview pages and check readiness. Every change is recorded with the connection that made it, and changes are rate limited.

Limits: one signer per document; signature, text, date and checkbox fields only; up to 500 fields and 20 MB per PDF; detection reads the first 25 pages. Initials, radio groups and multi-party signing are not supported in this connector; it will tell you when a PDF needs them.

Data: documents you upload are kept in your DocuDetect account, and uploaded source PDFs and copies are stored permanently. Do not put government ID numbers, bank or card numbers or health information into documents you prepare here. Details are in the privacy policy.

You need a DocuDetect account to sign in. Create one at docudetect.com.
capabilities: Upload a PDF as a draft through a one-time link
Detect and preview fields on a document
Place signature, text, date and checkbox fields
Fill in known values without moving fields
Copy master forms for each client or property
Check templates for missed or misplaced fields
Send for signature, track, remind and cancel
defaultPrompt: Show my draft documents and which ones still need a signer.
Upload a PDF as a draft, detect its fields and show me page 1 before saving.
Copy my Templates form into a new folder for 100 Example Street and fill in my details.

positive.prompt: Show my DocuDetect folders and how many drafts are in each.
positive.expected_behavior: Two folders, Templates (3 drafts) and 100 Example Street, with counts. The reply says the connection can read, and whether it can write.

positive.prompt: In the 100 Example Street folder, show the Sample Listing Agreement's fields as a list: page, type and label.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of the saved fields (text lines, three checkboxes on page 2, signature and date pairs on page 3), with the document revision.

positive.description: Copy a form and fill one value
positive.prompt: Copy the Sample Showing Instructions from Templates into 100 Example Street and set the "Contact name" to Alex Agent.
positive.expected_behavior: A new draft in the property folder. The "Contact name" field holds Alex Agent. No other field has a value. The source in Templates is unchanged.

positive.description: Set the signer and check readiness
positive.prompt: Set the signer of the Sample Listing Agreement copy in 100 Example Street to Sam Seller, the signer email address given in the review notes, and tell me if it is ready to send.
positive.expected_behavior: Signer saved. check_ready lists blockers or reports ready, and gives an app link. The reply says nothing was sent.

positive.prompt: Send the Sample Listing Agreement copy in 100 Example Street to Sam Seller at the signer email address given in the review notes, then tell me if Sam has opened it.
positive.tools_triggered: list_documents, get_document, set_recipient, check_ready, send_document, get_document
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant shows the title, signer and field count, sends, reports delivery email_sent, and reports the signing state (waiting until the signer opens the link).

positive.prompt: Start field detection on the Sample Seller Disclosure draft and tell me how many fields it suggests. Don't save them.
positive.expected_behavior: A job starts, polling ends with status done and a count of suggested fields. The reply says the suggestions were not saved. The document's revision is unchanged.

negative.prompt: Send the Sample Listing Agreement to the buyer for signature now.
negative.expected_behavior: No send_document call. No buyer name or email was given, so the assistant asks for the signer's name and email and does not guess or take one from the document. No email is sent.

negative.prompt: Delete the draft called Sample Showing Instructions from my account.
negative.expected_behavior: No delete tool exists. The assistant says it cannot delete and that documents are deleted in the app. The draft is still there afterwards.

negative.prompt: Sign the listing agreement for me with my signature.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant cannot sign. If it tries `set_field_values` on a signature field the connector refuses it. The signature field stays empty.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Upload PDFs as drafts (in-chat upload box), detect, check and preview fields, place and fill fields, copy documents, set the signer, send for signature on request, track, remind, renew, cancel and reopen, email signed copies, and organise folders. Nothing is signed or deleted by the connector.
